text: Here is the final demo sign-up, for November thirtieth and December fourth. Once you open it, this card shows up in the This week block on the home page.
The page starts with a short Demo day brief: why it matters, what to bring, timing, and a reminder to test on the room's screen. That text is a draft for you to approve.
Each night has thirteen ten-minute slots, timed from the start of class. A student picks an open slot and types a one-line title.
Their slot is highlighted. They can move it, change the title, or give it up until you lock the order. Classmates see first names and titles only.
It works the same on a phone.
In your view, you drag people, or nudge them up and down, move them between nights, and add a guest or an auditor to any open slot.
Then copy the running order as plain text, to read from on the night.
Set a lock time, and after it only you can change the order. Friday's start time isn't in the calendar yet, so its slots show no times.
Right now it's closed. Students see nothing until you press Open sign-up to the class.
